placement: Optional operation within D53 review preparation, connected to D54 discussion and D52 bounded resource work. Existing D53 records and D54 checker remain backward compatible; no required migration.
requirement: Question map -> coverage check -> bounded followup -> closure, after same-topic Medium observation.

native_record.branch_unit: An information condition, modeling assumption and evaluation/use relationship that changes understanding or choice. Papers, names and variants are not universal branch units.

synthesis_locator.excerpt: Exact nonempty excerpt in report_ref; located against the same read buffer used for report identity. Semantic support still needs human appraisal.

synthesized_requirements: Nonempty finding_ids resolve to evidence-map findings
All declared source IDs and finding source references resolve in source ledger; branch source IDs cover finding references
Required support records declare included/retrieved, nonempty artifact_path, actual reading status/parts and an accessible bounded source artifact
Branch excerpt exists in report; source existence alone cannot upgrade a branch

budget.max_sources: nonnegative integer; zero legal for synthesis of existing material
budget.new_source_unit: new source/material records within this bounded action, declared consistently in its observation, not all search hits

completed.receipt_refs: nonempty root-relative readable execution/observation file references

observation.boundary: Measured values are provider declarations linked to actual receipt bytes; this checker does not execute the followup or infer true usage from prose.

native_record.remaining_branch_ids_rule: Exact set of non-synthesized branches except deliberately_excluded and nonessential branches. Every nonessential open gap is still listed; essential gaps block deliver.
native_record.revision_rule: previous_map_ref retains prior ID, distinct version and nonempty change_reason; retain old branch IDs, including deliberately excluded ones. No silent deletion.
native_record.source_window: Uses declared selected versions and source records; date/eligibility judgment is not automatically inferred by the coverage checker. Use existing acquisition/version guard and reading process.
native_record.artifact_path: Native D53 acquisition.artifact_path; legacy top-level alias allowed only if absent or the same resolved path. Conflicting aliases fail.
native_record.parts_read: Nonempty string locators or objects with specific locator/pages/block/section values. Empty locators fail.

checker.path_policy: Explicit root-relative paths; containment after resolution; no whole-drive discovery; bounded reads; same-buffer identity; exclusive new output.
checker.budget_policy: Over-limit observation yields needs_work and explicit budget_exceeded; completed status does not silently upgrade coverage.
checker.semantic_boundary: Exact excerpt presence and declared finding/source/reading links are structural checks, not evidence entailment. A mislabeled name-only excerpt can pass them. Application/theory reviewer appraises substantive conditions, alternatives and choice before scientific closure.
checker.input_output_boundary: The new output must differ from every declared input path, including currently missing report/ledger/source/result/receipt paths.
checker.continue_policy: At least one bounded planned/blocked action targets a remaining gap; it may be nonessential. Other unresolved critical branches stay visible and still block deliver. No requirement to schedule all gaps in this round.
checker.needs_synthesis_policy: read_not_synthesized remains a diagnostic gap, not a mandatory route. The application reviewer chooses synthesis, version/counterevidence work or an explicit stop/defer based on the current purpose.
checker.source_receipt_path: Optional acquisition.receipt_path is validated as root-relative and reserved against output aliases; it is not inferred as scientific evidence.

effort_policy.basis: One same-topic natural-completion observation:6/9 in both runs; shorter Medium runtime/output.
effort_policy.critical_appraisal: Allocate verification to consequential conflicts/version/method decisions; compare specific nodes before a general model assignment.
effort_policy.scope: Project provisional operating preference; no global Codex configuration or agent role mutation.

conditional_alternatives: Existing table or research platform with equivalent recorded relations and real evidence
Narrow/defer/stop with reason instead of mandatory gap completion
Systematic reviews retain their own specific protocol
No fixed topic list, universal percentage or paper quota

program_checks.relocated_example_verdicts: equal after sorting branch-keyed gap collections
program_checks.independent_review: Four initial issues and residual IR04 repaired; limited final recheck accepted.

retrospective_four_case_mapping.actual_material: 2,963,110 bytes of selected prior source artifacts copied with byte identity; original reports/excerpts retained
retrospective_four_case_mapping.parent_clarification: R2 platform means analysis software ecosystem, not sequencing/capture platform; R2 representative excerpt and derived finding scope narrowed.
retrospective_four_case_mapping.scope: Representative saved-artifact application and bounded plans, not prospective coverage efficacy.
